name: Lemonade Stand Simulator
detailed_description:
When life gives you lemons, make lemonade

Plant your own orchard, cultivate your saplings, and bring the freshest flavors of nature to your stand!
“Lemonade Stand Simulator” is a rich and tranquil first-person drink stand simulation where you grow your own fruit and sell the city’s favorite beverages.

Plant Saplings, Harvest Fruit
Grow lemon, orange, and more in your garden. As your trees mature, pick the fruit and produce your own drinks. Every sapling is an investment; every harvest, a profit.

Squeeze the Fruit, Capture the Flavor
Press your freshly picked fruits, create blends, and craft your signature juices. Enhance your drinks to boost customer satisfaction and sales.

Expand Your Stand
Begin with a humble lemonade stand and scale up as traffic grows. Use your space wisely to increase production, sales, and earnings.

Cyclical Progression & Strategic Choices
Unlock new fruits, scale up capacity, and diversify your menu to meet customer demands. It’s in your hands to build the most efficient system with limited space and resources!

Can you rise from humble sapling to build your own drink brand? Or will you just linger in the garden?

“Lemonade Stand Simulator” – Join the adventure from Orchard to Glass!
